//: [fix4-front2] front face: band / slot proportion (A2), charger windows (A4, S9), tool actions (M6), lens flush / gasket stack (m9), service connector (S12), lights / ports solids (G5)
//bands: A2: both lens bands (front = rear) 20 -> 17.5 mm tall (R8.75 ends), top edge raised 0.5 mm (band z 164..184 -> 167..184.5): the body strips round the band become 5.1 mm (slot top 161.7 -> lens bottom 166.8) and 5.2 mm (lens top 184.3 -> body cut line 189.5) instead of 2.0 / 5.7

housing.//: A2: no clamp over the port frame (port_clear 0), flange over the slot 2.0 (was 0.9 light trap), gasket continuous round the lens (also over the slot) with two 3 mm drain breaks on the bottom run at |y| 100; m9: weld land 0.20 into the lens = the displacement-controlled collapse 0.20 +- 0.05 (was 0.05)

bosses.//: M6: horizontal boss axes (+-x) so one internal slide per end forms all four bosses (front: with the port frame's outside); m9: the ears float 0.4 on a steel sleeve (OD 3.0, seated on the boss top) under a wave spring (OD 5.5, 0.5 compressed) that pushes the module onto the crush pads; fitted / slot / clearance holes on the sleeve

pads.//: m9: four crush pads per module at the outer edge of the flange (two beyond the stadium ends on the band axis, two on the bottom run at |y| 86 over the lower ears) bear on the body's inner skin: they set the lens flushness and the gasket stand-off (0.8)

stack.//: m9 tolerance chains (mm, +-): flushness of the lens to the body A-surface; gasket installed height
f3_ear_seat: housing ear seat to weld land
f4_crush_pad: housing pad face to weld land (one cavity)
body wall at the opening (inner skin to A-surface)

harness.//: S12: IP67 sealed service pair (mating seal collar + wire-seal boots, model) raised 2 mm on its cradle; the lead runs down from it (drip edge); G5: cable / lead paths relaxed in lightkit (bend >= 1.6 r)

ports3.//: S9: windows sized for +-2 deg heading error at every lateral / vertical misalignment (pins rotated about the seated tip mid-point, then driven along x); A4: all four window corners R3 (one corner language inside the R10 stadium); renderer: clean chassis pocket stand-in in the port views
ports3.//hood: A4: one ring per duct on to the chassis with a scarfed end instead of ring + hood: x_end 307.7 (1 mm before the chassis ledge) up to the window bottom, 304.5 (1 mm before the chassis face) from the R3 tangent up, one slanted plane between - the floor and the lower R3 corners end along one line (f3: hood from 2.5 above the window bottom = through the arc: a visible tick at both lower corners in the headlit close-ups). hood_lift = the footprint height used for the 304.5 end
ports3.//ts_simplify: G5: the symmetric tunnel outline (tunnel x its mirror) simplified to 0.01 before the windows are cut from it: no zigzag window top, no self-intersecting web bevel
ports3.//lip: M6 / A4: lip_fill = R of the slot's rim roll: the tunnel bore starts at the crest of the bottom lip (the f2 / f3 0.36 mm trough behind the lip was an undercut for the front slider and a water trap)
